PropertyMap._comment_InputStreamArn: REQUIRED: ARN of the Kinesis Data Stream containing shift opportunity events
PropertyMap._comment_OpenSearchEndpoint: REQUIRED: Amazon OpenSearch Service cluster endpoint URL
PropertyMap._comment_Authentication: OPTIONAL: Basic auth credentials (not recommended for production)
PropertyMap._comment_IAM_Preferred: For production, omit username/password to use IAM authentication
PropertyMap._comment_S3Backup: OPTIONAL: S3 configuration for backup storage and disaster recovery
PropertyMap._comment_Region: AWS region for IAM authentication (default: us-east-1)
PropertyMap._comment_ProcessingMode: conditional (safe, out-of-order protection) or fast (max speed)
PropertyMap._comment_IndexNames: OpenSearch index names (configurable with sensible defaults)
